Mastering Facebook Ads: Meta Ads — Beginner to Expert

Build a campaign, research public competitor ads, and install, test and troubleshoot website measurement with Meta Pixel.

AED 50
46-page PDFDigital course
Beginner to advanced practiceLearn at your pace

What you’ll learn

  • Set up your business portfolio, ad account, payment settings and secure access.
  • Build a WhatsApp campaign around a clear offer, audience, budget and creative.
  • Test the complete customer journey, handle enquiries and review useful results.
  • Work through phone-call, website-traffic and Shopify-sales campaign scenarios.
  • Research public competitor ads in Meta Ad Library and turn observations into a creative test.
  • Choose a Pixel installation route, map real action events and verify the browser and Meta Test Events.
  • Understand Conversions API, browser/server event deduplication, consent and troubleshooting.
  • Complete the campaign worksheets and website-measurement sign-off checklist.

Inside the course

01   Get the foundations right

Account setup and secure access, pages 2–3. Campaign roadmap, page 4. Offer, goal and spending boundary, page 5.

02   Connect, build and create

WhatsApp connection, page 6. Campaign structure, page 7. Audience, budget and schedule, page 8. Creative and conversation starters, page 9.

03   Launch, measure and improve

Test the whole journey, page 10. Handle enquiries, page 11. Measure results and choose the next change, pages 12–13.

04   Work through your own campaign

Launch checklist, page 14. Campaign brief, page 15. Enquiry tracker, page 16. First-test review, page 17.

05   Explore other business goals

Website tracking foundations, page 18. Phone calls, website traffic and Shopify sales, pages 19–22.

06   Read the interface and research public ads

Visual walkthrough and working levels, pages 23–25. Four competitor-research pages covering search, filters, analysis and a creative-test worksheet, pages 26–29.

07   Install the Pixel and map real events

Understand website measurement and select the source, pages 30–31. Partner/manual installation and Tag Manager, pages 32–34. Event mapping and success-triggered action events, pages 35–36.

08   Verify and troubleshoot measurement

Test Events, page 37. Conversions API and deduplication, pages 38–39. Consent and privacy, page 40. Troubleshooting and final sign-off, pages 41–42.

09   Use the references and teaching captures

Official references and publication notes, pages 43–46. Eight sanitised interface captures, 34 reference links and 46 PDF bookmarks support the lessons.

Made for you if…

For business owners and marketers who want campaign foundations, a practical public-ad research method and a structured approach to website measurement.

What’s included

  • The complete 46-page English PDF
  • Campaign lessons, scenarios, checklists and worksheets
  • Four pages of public competitor-ad research
  • Thirteen pages of Pixel setup, event testing and measurement guidance
  • Eight sanitised real interface captures
  • 34 reference links and 46 PDF bookmarks

Before you begin

You will need an eligible Meta account and access to the business assets you use. Running ads requires a separate advertising budget. The WhatsApp example does not require a website; the Pixel lessons require an eligible website you are authorised to configure.

An independent Ascore educational course. Meta screens, policies and eligibility can change. Interface captures are sanitised teaching examples; Pixel implementation guidance is clearly labelled. Advertising performance and certification are not guaranteed.
